title: Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents commonly use the full interaction history as a proxy for state, retaining all past observations and actions regardless of whether they remain relevant. We instead ask what information an agent actually needs to carry forward. We define agent state as a compact abstraction of interaction history that preserves the competence of a fixed reference agent, with the minimal such abstraction as the ideal. Because matching the reference agent's behavior is unnecessarily restrictive and difficult for black-box policies, we define sufficiency through task performance rather than behavior matching. We represent state abstractions as deterministic recursive programs and search over them using an LLM-guided genetic algorithm. Across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, the learned abstractions preserve near-reference task success while reducing mean policy input by up to 71% and 57%, respectively. translated_title: 为大语言模型智能体学习紧凑的状态抽象
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常将完整的交互历史作为状态的替代，无论过去的观察和动作是否仍然相关，都全部予以保留。我们转而探究智能体真正需要携带哪些信息前进。我们将智能体状态定义为交互历史的一种紧凑抽象，它能够保持某个固定参考智能体的能力，并以最小的此类抽象作为理想目标。由于匹配参考智能体的行为对黑盒策略而言过于局限且困难，我们通过任务表现而非行为匹配来定义充分性。我们将状态抽象表示为确定性递归程序，并使用由大语言模型引导的遗传算法对其进行搜索。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld基准上，学习到的抽象保持了接近参考智能体的任务成功率，同时将策略的平均输入分别减少了高达71%和57%。所得到的程序是可直接检查审查的。
tldr: 本文提出将智能体状态定义为交互历史的紧凑抽象，以确定性递归程序表示并用LLM引导的遗传算法搜索，在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上保持接近参考智能体的任务成功率的同时，将策略输入最多减少71%和57%，且得到的程序可直接审查。
en_tdlr: This paper defines agent state as compact abstractions of interaction history represented as deterministic recursive programs, searched via an LLM-guided genetic algorithm, achieving near-reference task success on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld while reducing policy input by up to 71% and 57%, with directly inspectable resulting programs.
